articles.title: Strong GST collections signal resilient growth, but inflation risks linger
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: Strong GST collections indicate a resilient Indian economy, though inflation remains a concern.
articles.explain: GST is a consumption tax levied on the sale of goods and services. When collections are high, it suggests people are spending more, which signals economic growth. However, inflation—the rising cost of goods—can offset these gains, making it a balancing act for policymakers to keep the economy growing without prices spiraling.

story.title: Indian Economic Growth and Inflation
story.so_far: India has been focusing on post-pandemic economic recovery through tax reform and infrastructure development. The Goods and Services Tax (GST) is a unified tax system introduced to simplify commerce across states, and its collection figures are a primary metric for gauging the health of the Indian consumer market.

timeline.text: Recent GST data shows steady economic growth alongside persistent inflationary risks.

articles.explain: Implementing AI in large businesses is difficult because it requires not just technical skill, but deep 'domain expertise'—or specific knowledge about how a particular industry (like banking or manufacturing) works. articles.title: MNRE to seek undertakings from solar manufacturers against DCR violations
articles.source: Business News Today: Latest Business New
articles.summary: The Ministry of New and Renewable Energy (MNRE) is taking a stricter stance on solar manufacturing compliance.
articles.explain: DCR (Domestic Content Requirement) is a policy meant to encourage 'Make in India.' It requires developers to buy solar panels made in India rather than cheaper imported ones. Asking for 'undertakings' means the government wants official, signed legal promises that companies will follow these rules to avoid penalties.

story.title: Solar Manufacturing Regulatory Compliance
story.so_far: India has been pushing for solar energy independence under initiatives like 'Atmanirbhar Bharat.' To support this, they use DCR rules, which mandate that solar projects must use locally manufactured components to qualify for government incentives.

timeline.text: The government is seeking formal undertakings from solar executives to prevent violations of Domestic Content Requirement (DCR) rules.

articles.title: IDBI Bank stake sale: Why employees are protesting against Fairfax deal and demanding privatisation rollback
articles.summary: Employees are protesting the sale of a majority stake in IDBI Bank to Fairfax.
articles.explain: Privatization is the process of transferring ownership of a state-owned company to a private entity. Employees often protest this because they fear that private ownership might lead to job cuts, changes in working conditions, or the loss of public-sector job security. Fairfax is an international holding company that is the planned buyer for this stake.

story.title: IDBI Bank Privatization Dispute
story.so_far: IDBI Bank has been undergoing a long restructuring process. The Indian government and the Life Insurance Corporation of India (LIC) hold majority stakes and have been looking to divest or 'privatize' the bank to reduce the state's role in the banking sector.

timeline.text: Following the government's October 14 approval of the deal, bank employees have launched protests seeking to stop the privatization.
